document: f2_spectrum/recovery_w1: W1-BASE, with the full method grid
status: candidate reference, derived and self-checked by its author TASK; no independent refutation has been made yet
deliverable: DEL-04-10 (response spectrum: CLM-001 recovery), on DEL-04-09's modal basis

number_format.flush: a value below 1e-50 of the largest magnitude of its unit in its block is printed as 0; a value between 1e-50 and 1e-35 of it is refused at generation

conventions.excitation: p_k = (M R_k)_f, R_k the rigid unit translation of every DOF, consistent-mass coupling to restrained DOFs included; Gamma = phi^T p_k / m, m_eff = (phi^T p_k)^2 / m, T_k = R_k^T M R_k over all DOFs.
conventions.modal_response: u_ik = Gamma_ik s_k S_k(f_i) / omega_i^2 phi_i on all DOFs, relative to the supports; inertia field g = omega_i^2 u_ik; inertia load M g.
conventions.rigid_response: g = a_r,k (R_k - sum over periodic modes of Gamma_ik phi_i), F_k = M g over all DOFs; K_ff u_f = F_k,f; a_r,k = s_k S_k(f_r).
conventions.element_end_forces: f_e = K_e u_e - M_e g_e: the 12 generalized forces acting on the element at node i then node j, Fx Fy Fz Mx My Mz. M_e is the member's own consistent mass (absent where an eligible body replaces it); a body's inertia acts at its node, not in any element.
conventions.reactions: the generalized force the support applies to the piping, global axes: (K u - M g) at each restrained DOF, which includes mass at restrained DOFs, consistent coupling and a body coupled to a restrained DOF.
conventions.member_axes: for a member from node i to node j: x = (x_j - x_i)/|x_j - x_i|, y = y_reference less its x part, normalized, z = x cross y; Lambda has rows x, y, z; each 3-vector of a global end force is rotated by Lambda. Combined member-axis magnitudes combine the rotated signed contributions; they are not rotations of combined global magnitudes.
conventions.constituents: metal_translational and contents and insulation_translational: Hermitian consistent translation mass plus linear axial mass of that part's mass per length; metal_rotary and insulation_rotary: Rayleigh rotary inertia plus linear torsional mass of that part's j_bar (i_bar = j_bar / 2); contents carry no rotary or torsional inertia; component_body: the body's point mass W/a at its centre of gravity, no rotary inertia of its own. The six constituent matrices sum exactly to the assembled M.
conventions.shares: an inertia share is M_c g (constituent), M_e g_e (member) or M_b g_b (body); its resultant is the total force and the moment about the global origin, sum over nodes of (q_M + x cross q_F).
conventions.combinations: per response quantity on signed values: SRSS, CQC (Der Kiureghian rho, r = omega_j / omega_i, zeta of the spectra), GROUPING (ascending, a group takes each next mode within 10 % of its lowest, inclusive), TEN_PERCENT (every pair within 10 %, inclusive), ABSOLUTE_SUM; rigid with periodic by SRSS or ABSOLUTE_SUM, or OFF (every extracted mode periodic, no rigid response); directions by SRSS, 100-40-40 (factor exactly 2/5) or ABSOLUTE_SUM. Every extracted scope cluster here is a single mode.
conventions.spectra: interpolated on the table's own abscissa (period for a period table, x = 1/f); no extrapolation; ln and exp from Decimal at the working precision.

variant.purpose: Branched EX frame: inclined eccentric chord, eligible valve body with an offset centre of gravity next to a restrained DOF, contents and insulation, positive mill and corrosion, state-selected modulus. Full method grid.

steel_state.rule: G = E / (2 (1 + nu)), exact; equals the stated binary64 value 76000000000

derived_model.formation_field: exact Q + Q*pi (every member's unit axis is rational)

formation_identity.mass: exactly equal in Q + Q*pi, every entry

displacements.keys: <node>.<dof> for every node, zero at restrained DOFs
